name: THOMAS CHACRA
addressee: To the Underwriting Services team, Zurich Insurance, Zaventem.
subject: Application: Traineeship Insurance Administrator (137418), Thomas Chacra
paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Traineeship Insurance Administrator position within Underwriting Services in Zaventem. My academic background is in environmental bioengineering rather than economics or finance, and I am aware that this is not the most conventional profile for the department. I am applying nonetheless because of the nature of the work itself. Once a contract is signed, your team turns an agreement into accurate policies, endorsements and invoices, and that is the kind of rigorous administrative work I want to learn properly.

My experience to date has been in data and reporting rather than in insurance, though the underlying discipline is comparable. I have built Excel and Power BI tools that replaced recurring manual reporting, and I was responsible for validating the data feeding those tools. I also designed a Power Automate workflow that filed client documents in the correct folders, which reduced the time needed to retrieve supporting evidence. In one analysis, automating the process reduced processing time to approximately 30 % of the original.

I do not have professional experience in insurance and I do not speak Dutch, so I would begin the traineeship with genuine gaps to close. My French and English are both at C1, which satisfies the language requirement of the posting, and I am available to work in Zaventem. I understand that the first months would involve learning your systems and procedures from the outset, and that is the prospect that interests me.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss the three rotations and how I could contribute to the International or European team. Thank you for considering my application.
